name: DataGridFilterBar
purpose: Presentation container for composing data-grid filter controls.
knownLimitations: Presentation container only; filter state belongs to DataGridState/controlled integrations, and the compact header does not provide an inline filter popover.
useWhen: Use to group filter UI within a grid surface while filter state is owned by DataGridState or another controlled integration.
avoidWhen: Avoid expecting it to own filter state, query semantics, or an inline filter popover.
accessibilityNotes: The component adds only a div container; child filter controls remain responsible for their own accessible labels, roles, and keyboard behavior.
aiUsageNotes: Treat as layout/presentation only; keep filter state and business query behavior in shared grid state or the consuming application.
